context: Integrating an imperative third-party map SDK into a React page. This is a legitimate external-system effect; graded on containing it in a reviewed domain hook with honest dependencies instead of direct effects in the component.

checklist.name: Effects confined to a named map hook
checklist.description: All `useEffect` code lives in one domain-specific hook named for the map integration (for example `useAcmeMap`) in its own file; the `StoreMap` component itself neither imports nor calls `useEffect` or `React.useEffect`. A component that calls `useEffect` directly scores 0.

checklist.name: Hook exposes reactive inputs honestly
checklist.description: The hook takes the map inputs (center, zoom, and the move-end callback or an equivalent) as explicit parameters and either takes the container ref or returns one it owns; it lists every reactive value its setup and cleanup read in the dependency arrays (refs for creation-time options or the latest callback are fine), and contains no `eslint-disable` for `react-hooks/exhaustive-deps`.

checklist.name: No generic effect wrapper
checklist.description: The solution does not add a generic helper that accepts a callback plus a caller-provided dependency array (such as `useMountEffect(fn)`, `useUpdateEffect(fn, deps)`, or `useAsyncEffect`).

checklist.name: Lifecycle correct
checklist.description: `StoreMap` renders a host element carrying the hook's container ref; the map is created once per container, follows `center` and `zoom` changes with `setCenter`/`setZoom` without recreating it, subscribes to `moveend` and unsubscribes, calls `onMoveEnd` with `getCenter()`, and calls `destroy()` on unmount.

checklist.name: Map mounted on the locator page
checklist.description: `src/stores/StoreLocatorPage.tsx` imports `StoreMap` and renders it in place of the TODO with the page's `center`, zoom 12, and a move-end callback that updates `center` (`setCenter` directly or an equivalent wrapper). An unused `StoreMap` with the TODO left in place scores 0.

checklist.name: Notes and checks
checklist.description: `NOTES.md` explains that the map is an external system synchronized through the hook, and reports the lint, type, or component checks actually run (or states they could not run) without inventing results.
